name: youtube
label: YouTube
description: Enjoy the videos and music you love, upload original content, and share it all with friends, family, and the world on YouTube

download_caption.label: Download Caption
download_caption.description: Download a caption track's text. Works only on videos you own.

captionId.label: Caption ID
captionId.description: From List Captions. Auto-generated tracks can't be downloaded.

format.label: Format
format.description: File format of the captions. Empty: the track's original format.

targetLanguage.label: Target Language
targetLanguage.description: Translate the captions into this language code.

onBehalfOfContentOwner.label: On Behalf Of Content Owner
onBehalfOfContentOwner.description: Content owner ID, for YouTube partners who manage many channels.

list_captions.label: List Captions
list_captions.description: List a video's caption tracks, with the IDs Download Caption needs.

videoId.label: Video ID
videoId.description: The v= value in the video's URL, such as dQw4w9WgXcQ.

captionIds.label: Caption IDs
captionIds.description: Only return these tracks. Separate caption IDs with commas.

onBehalfOfContentOwner.label: On Behalf Of Content Owner
onBehalfOfContentOwner.description: Content owner ID, for YouTube partners who manage many channels.

get_video.label: Get Video
get_video.description: Retrieve a video by ID, including its statistics and duration.

videoIds.label: Video IDs
videoIds.description: A video ID, or several separated by commas: the v= value in each video's URL.

get_channel.label: Get Channel
get_channel.description: Get a channel's details, including subscriber and view counts.

channelId.label: Channel ID
channelId.description: The channel's ID, which starts with UC. Leave empty to look the channel up by Handle.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: The @name on the channel page. Used only when Channel ID is empty.

list_playlists.label: List Playlists
list_playlists.description: List the playlists on a channel.

channelId.label: Channel ID
channelId.description: The channel's ID, which starts with UC.

maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.description: How many playlists to return, from 1 to 50.

pageToken.label: Page Token
pageToken.description: The nextPageToken from an earlier run, to get the next page.

create_playlist.label: Create Playlist
create_playlist.description: Create a new playlist on the connected account's channel.

privacyStatus.label: Privacy Status
privacyStatus.description: Who can see the playlist. Defaults to private.

defaultLanguage.label: Default Language
defaultLanguage.description: BCP-47 language code of the title and description (for example: en, es, ja).

update_playlist.label: Update Playlist
update_playlist.description: Update the title, description, tags or privacy of an existing playlist.

playlistId.label: Playlist ID
playlistId.description: The playlist to update. The list= value in the playlist's URL.

title.label: Title
title.description: New title. Leave blank to keep the current title.

description.label: Description
description.description: New description. Leave blank to keep the current description.

tagsMode.label: Tags Update Mode
tagsMode.description: How to treat the Tags field. Leave Unchanged keeps the existing tags.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags to set when Tags Update Mode is Replace.

privacyStatus.label: Privacy Status
privacyStatus.description: New privacy. Leave Unchanged keeps the current value.

defaultLanguage.label: Default Language
defaultLanguage.description: BCP-47 language code of the title and description. Leave blank to keep the current value.

delete_playlist.label: Delete Playlist
delete_playlist.description: Permanently delete a playlist owned by the connected account.

playlistId.label: Playlist ID
playlistId.description: The playlist to delete. The list= value in the playlist's URL.

add_video_to_playlist.label: Add Video To Playlist
add_video_to_playlist.description: Add a video to a playlist owned by the connected account.

playlistId.label: Playlist ID
playlistId.description: The playlist to add to. The list= value in the playlist's URL.

videoId.label: Video ID
videoId.description: The v= value in the video's URL, such as dQw4w9WgXcQ.

position.label: Position
position.description: Zero-based position in the playlist. Leave blank to append to the end.

remove_video_from_playlist.label: Remove Video From Playlist
remove_video_from_playlist.description: Remove one entry from a playlist owned by the connected account.

playlistItemId.label: Playlist Item ID
playlistItemId.description: The playlist item ID (a long opaque string), not the video ID. Obtain it from List Playlist Videos or Add Video To Playlist.

post_video_comment.label: Post Video Comment
post_video_comment.description: Post a new top-level comment on a video.

videoId.label: Video ID
videoId.description: The v= value in the video's URL, such as dQw4w9WgXcQ.

reply_to_comment.label: Reply To Comment
reply_to_comment.description: Reply to an existing top-level comment.

parentCommentId.label: Parent Comment ID
parentCommentId.description: The ID of a top-level comment, from `items[].snippet.topLevelComment.id` in List Comment Threads. Reply IDs are not accepted.

delete_comment.label: Delete Comment
delete_comment.description: Permanently delete a comment or reply.

commentId.label: Comment ID
commentId.description: The comment or reply ID, from List Comment Threads or from Post Video Comment.

set_comment_moderation_status.label: Set Comment Moderation Status
set_comment_moderation_status.description: Publish, hold for review, or reject comments on the connected account's videos.

commentIds.label: Comment IDs
commentIds.description: A comment ID, or a comma-separated list of comment IDs, from List Comment Threads.

moderationStatus.label: Moderation Status
moderationStatus.description: The status to apply to every listed comment.

banAuthor.label: Ban Author
banAuthor.description: Permanently ban the comment author from the channel. Only valid with the Rejected status and cannot be undone.

set_comment_moderation_status.afterResponse: return {success: true, commentIds: inputs.commentIds, moderationStatus: inputs.moderationStatus};

rate_video.label: Rate Video
rate_video.description: Like, dislike, or remove the rating on a video.

videoId.label: Video ID
videoId.description: The v= value in the video's URL, such as dQw4w9WgXcQ.

rating.label: Rating
rating.description: The rating to apply. None removes any existing rating.

rate_video.afterResponse: return {success: true, videoId: inputs.videoId, rating: inputs.rating};

get_video_rating.label: Get Video Rating
get_video_rating.description: Read the rating the connected account has given to one or more videos.

videoIds.label: Video IDs
videoIds.description: A video ID, or up to 50 separated by commas: the v= value in each video's URL.

list_channel_activities.label: List Channel Activities
list_channel_activities.description: List recent activity events on a channel, such as uploads and playlist additions.

channelId.label: Channel ID
channelId.description: The channel's ID, which starts with UC. Leave empty to list the connected account's own activity.

publishedAfter.label: Published After
publishedAfter.description: Only activities created at or after this time (RFC 3339).

publishedBefore.label: Published Before
publishedBefore.description: Only activities created before this time (RFC 3339).

regionCode.label: Region Code
regionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (for example: US, DE, JP).

maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.description: How many activities to return, from 0 to 50.

pageToken.label: Page Token
pageToken.description: The nextPageToken from an earlier run, to get the next page.

list_my_subscriptions.label: List My Subscriptions
list_my_subscriptions.description: List the channels the connected account is subscribed to.

forChannelId.label: For Channel ID
forChannelId.description: Only return the subscription to this channel, if one exists. Returns an empty list otherwise.

maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.description: How many subscriptions to return, from 0 to 50.

pageToken.label: Page Token
pageToken.description: The nextPageToken from an earlier run, to get the next page.

list_trending_videos.label: List Trending Videos
list_trending_videos.description: List the most popular videos in a region, optionally by category.

regionCode.label: Region Code
regionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (for example: US, DE, JP). Empty: US.

videoCategoryId.label: Video Category ID
videoCategoryId.description: Restrict the chart to one video category ID (for example: 10 for Music). Leave blank for all categories.

maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.description: How many videos to return, from 1 to 50.

pageToken.label: Page Token
pageToken.description: The nextPageToken from an earlier run, to get the next page.

list_channel_videos.label: List Channel Videos
list_channel_videos.description: List the videos a channel has uploaded.

channel.label: Channel ID or Handle
channel.description: A channel ID starting with `UC`, or a handle such as `@GoogleDevelopers`.

maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.description: How many videos to return, from 0 to 50.

pageToken.label: Page Token
pageToken.description: The nextPageToken from an earlier run, to get the next page.

update_video_metadata.label: Update Video Metadata
update_video_metadata.description: Update the title, description, tags, category or status of a video you own.

videoId.label: Video ID
videoId.description: The v= value in the video's URL, such as dQw4w9WgXcQ.

title.label: Title
title.description: New title. Leave blank to keep the current title.

description.label: Description
description.description: New description. Leave blank to keep the current description.

categoryId.label: Category ID
categoryId.description: New video category ID (for example: 10 for Music). Leave blank to keep the current category.

tagsMode.label: Tags Update Mode
tagsMode.description: How to treat the Tags field. Leave Unchanged keeps the existing tags.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags to set when Tags Update Mode is Replace.

defaultLanguage.label: Default Language
defaultLanguage.description: BCP-47 language code of the title and description. Leave blank to keep the current value.

privacyStatus.label: Privacy Status
privacyStatus.description: New privacy. Leave Unchanged keeps the current value.

license.label: License
license.description: New license. Leave Unchanged keeps the current value.

embeddable.label: Embeddable
embeddable.description: Whether the video can be embedded on other sites. Leave Unchanged keeps the current value.

publicStatsViewable.label: Public Stats Viewable
publicStatsViewable.description: Whether the video statistics are publicly visible. Leave Unchanged keeps the current value.

madeForKids.label: Made For Kids
madeForKids.description: Self-declaration that the video is made for kids. Leave Unchanged keeps the current value.

search_youtube.label: Search YouTube
search_youtube.description: Search YouTube for videos, channels and playlists.

query.label: Query
query.description: Words to search for. Use | for OR and - to leave a word out.

type.label: Type
type.description: Which kind of result to return. Video-only filters need Video.

forContentOwner.label: For Content Owner
forContentOwner.description: Only videos of the owner set in On Behalf Of Content Owner.

forDeveloper.label: For Developer
forDeveloper.description: Only videos uploaded through this connection's Google Cloud app.

forMine.label: For Mine
forMine.description: Only videos on the connected account. Needs Type set to Video.

onBehalfOfContentOwner.label: On Behalf Of Content Owner
onBehalfOfContentOwner.description: Content owner ID, for YouTube partners who manage many channels.

channelId.label: Channel ID
channelId.description: Only return results from this channel. The ID starts with UC.

channelType.label: Channel Type
channelType.description: Show returns only channels that publish TV shows.

safeSearch.label: Safe Search
safeSearch.description: Whether to leave out restricted content.

publishedAfter.label: Published After
publishedAfter.description: Only results published on or after this date.

publishedBefore.label: Published Before
publishedBefore.description: Only results published before this date.

maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.description: How many results to return, from 0 to 50.

pageToken.label: Page Token
pageToken.description: The nextPageToken from an earlier run, to get the next page.

regionCode.label: Region Code
regionCode.description: Two-letter country code. Results must be viewable there.

relevanceLanguage.label: Relevance Language
relevanceLanguage.description: Two-letter language code. Results in it rank higher.

topicId.label: Topic ID
topicId.description: Freebase topic ID to limit results to one topic.

eventType.label: Event Type
eventType.description: Video only. Limit to live, upcoming or finished broadcasts.

location.label: Location
location.description: Video only. Latitude,longitude. Needs Location Radius too.

locationRadius.label: Location Radius
locationRadius.description: Video only. Distance from Location in m, km, ft or mi.

videoCategoryId.label: Video Category ID
videoCategoryId.description: Video only. YouTube's numeric category ID, like 10 for Music.

videoEmbeddable.label: Video Embeddable
videoEmbeddable.description: Video only. True: only videos other sites can embed.

videoPaidProductPlacement.label: Video Paid Product Placement
videoPaidProductPlacement.description: Video only. True: only videos with paid promotions.

videoSyndicated.label: Video Syndicated
videoSyndicated.description: Video only. True: only videos that play outside youtube.com.

list_playlist_videos.label: List Playlist Videos
list_playlist_videos.description: List the videos in a playlist, or the playlist items with the given IDs.

playlistId.label: Playlist ID
playlistId.description: The list= value in the playlist's URL. Leave empty to use Item IDs.

itemIds.label: Item IDs
itemIds.description: Comma-separated playlist item IDs, used instead of Playlist ID.

maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.description: How many items to return, from 0 to 50.

pageToken.label: Page Token
pageToken.description: The nextPageToken from an earlier run, to get the next page.

videoId.label: Video ID
videoId.description: Only return entries for this video. Needs a Playlist ID.

list_comment_threads.label: List Comment Threads
list_comment_threads.description: List the top-level comment threads on a video.

videoId.label: Video ID
videoId.description: The v= value in the video's URL, such as dQw4w9WgXcQ.

order.label: Order
order.description: How to sort the comments. Empty: newest first.

maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.description: How many comment threads to return, from 1 to 100.

pageToken.label: Page Token
pageToken.description: The nextPageToken from an earlier run, to get the next page.

new-video.label: New Video In Channel
new-video.description: Runs when a new video is added to a YouTube channel.

channel_identifier.label: Channel ID, URL, or handle
channel_identifier.description: The channel's ID, its URL, or its handle, such as @DutchPilotGirl.
